notes: readXboxBroadcastAltPassword/writeXboxBroadcastAltPassword scope this secret per server via the account field (a server UUID, lines 78-89). SecretStore's key-naming scheme (secret-storage.md section 9) folds that scoping into the key itself: 'xbox-broadcast.alt-password.<server-id>'. After delete, get must return None, not a stale value or an error.
